title: The Half-Light Aftermath
author: Yara Fairweather
blurb: Quentin Eriksen, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the house sale closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
